## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Optimization / Algorithm enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Related Issues
Closes # (issue number)

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Backend tests passing (`pytest`)
- [ ] Frontend builds successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual verification via UI (`http://localhost:3000`)
- [ ] API endpoint verification (`/api/health`, `/api/optimize`, `/api/forecast`)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
- [ ] I have updated documentation accordingly
- [ ] No secrets or unneeded local files are committed
